name: seo-checklist
description: Deterministic SEO audit against a fixed 214-item registry (Plerdy 200 + 14 GEO/AI, schema and lab-vitals checks). Every item gets a status, nothing is silently skipped, and coverage is reported separately from the score. 55 evidence scripts, 4 judgement agents plus an adversarial reviewer, three run modes including a fully offline one.
